description: Query one World Bank indicator's values for countries across periods — the primary data tool; find indicator_id with worldbank_search_indicators. Set at most one of date_range, mrv, or mrnev, and frequency only without date_range. For "all" countries, page at up to 4000 per page. Indicators the standard data endpoint does not serve — WDI Database Archives, PEFA, ICP, GDLD, International Debt Statistics: DSSI, Food Prices for Nutrition — are answered from their own dataset; the response then carries sourceScoped, naming the dataset and the dimension value applied, since those values can be archived or superseded figures.

anyOf.description: One code, or several in one string.

countries.description: ISO2 (US) or ISO3 (USA) codes, regional (EAS, SSF), income (HIC, LMC), or world (WLD) aggregates, or "all" alone for every entry. One code, an array, or codes separated by commas, semicolons, or pipes (US,JP · US;JP · US|JP), in a string or an array element. An empty or separator-only value is rejected, never read as "all".

date_range.description: A period, or two of the same form joined by a colon, earliest first: years (`2020`, `2010:2023`), quarters (`2020Q1:2021Q4`), or months (`2020M01:2020M06`). On a series publishing several forms the window's form picks the periods, null-filled where the series lacks it (with a notice); on a single-form series a window at another form keeps the periods it overlaps (`2019:2021` on a quarterly series gives twelve quarters). A window outside the series returns no observations.

dimension_value.description: For a source-scoped indicator (the response carries sourceScoped), the value of its dataset's extra dimension, by id or full label, case-insensitively, ids matched first: a WDI Database Archives release ("202503" or "2025 Mar"), an ICP or Food Prices for Nutrition classification ("PPPGlob", "FPN 5.0"), a GDLD sector ("WHT"), or an International Debt Statistics counterpart area ("730" or "China"). Omit for the default, which sourceScoped.dimension reports.

frequency.description: Period form, for series that also publish quarterly or monthly values (Global Economic Monitor): annual (default; a series with no annual periods keeps its own), quarterly, or monthly. It applies to mrv and mrnev ("monthly" with mrv 3 gives the three latest months), or alone to the whole series. A form the series lacks returns no rows, or null rows on a whole-series read from a source that null-fills it; a notice says so.

indicator_id.description: One indicator ID (e.g. NY.GDP.PCAP.CD), not "all" or a list.

mrnev.description: Each requested country's own N latest non-null values (1–100), however far back; a country with fewer returns those it has, and one with none returns no rows.

mrv.description: The N latest periods (1–100, at most the series length) where any requested country has a value; every country comes back at those periods, null where it has none. Rows are mrv × countries.

per_page.description: Results per page (default: server default); sizes above 4000 are served at that maximum, with a notice.

source_id.description: Source dataset to read, subnational ones included (IDs from worldbank_list_sources); worldbank_list_countries with the same source_id lists its entity IDs. Omit for the standard endpoint with automatic fallback.

name: worldbank_get_data

appliedFilters.description: Parameters in force for these observations; a filter not applied is omitted.

countries.description: Country codes as requested, split and rejoined with semicolons.

perPage.description: Page size served, after any reduction to the page maximum.

requestedPerPage.description: Page size asked for, or the server default; present only when perPage was reduced.

currentPage.description: Page number; past totalPages when the request ran off the end.

countryCode.description: ISO2 code (US; XD for High income), or a source-only entity's opaque ID.

countryIso3.description: Three-character code (USA, HIC), the form countries takes; empty for an entity the World Bank country listing lacks.

dimension.description: This row's value of the dataset's extra dimension, on source-scoped rows of a dataset that has one.

isAggregate.description: True for a regional or income-group aggregate.

obsStatus.description: Observation status code flagging a data-quality note; empty when none.

value.description: Indicator value; null where the series has no data for this country and period, common in sparse series.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `source_not_found`: source_id does not name a source. `source_not_queryable`: The source lacks a country/series/time layout. `invalid_params`: More than one of date_range, mrv, and mrnev, or frequency with date_range. `mixed_all_selector`: countries mixes "all" with codes. `reversed_date_range`: date_range runs latest first. `multiple_indicators`: indicator_id is "all". `indicator_not_found`: Unknown indicator_id. `indicator_not_queryable`: Neither the standard data endpoint nor a source-scoped dataset can serve the indicator. `unknown_dimension_value`: dimension_value matches no id or label of the dataset's extra dimension. `ambiguous_dimension_value`: dimension_value is a label several values share. `dimension_not_applicable`: dimension_value is given for an indicator with no extra dimension. `source_scope_too_large`: A source-scoped query exceeds the per-request row limit. `country_not_found`: One or more country codes are invalid. `indicator_and_country_not_found`: Both indicator_id and country codes are invalid. `upstream_inconsistent`: The API's response cache answered a data read and its re-read with another query's rows. `upstream_timeout`: The World Bank Indicators API did not answer every read within the call's 50-second budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lastUpdated.description: Last update (YYYY-MM-DD) of the source that served these values, the vintage to cite; omitted when upstream reports none.

notice.description: Explains an empty result, a frequency the series lacks, a page past the end, an all-null date_range or frequency page, a reduced page size, or countries a source-scoped dataset lacks.

sourceId.description: ID of the source that served the values, when known.

sourceScoped.description: Present when the source-scoped data API served the values, for a source_id or the fallback.

concept.description: The extra dimension: Version, Classification, Sector, or Counterpart-Area.

id.description: Applied value id; null for every_value.

label.description: Applied value label; null for every_value.

selection.description: How the value was chosen: requested (dimension_value), only_value (the dataset's only value), world_total (WLD, all counterpart areas), newest_with_data (newest release with a value for the requested countries and periods), newest (newest release; none has one), or every_value (each row carries its own).

dimension.description: Dimension value applied; null when the dataset has no extra dimension.

sourceName.description: Serving source name, e.g. "WDI Database Archives".

title: Get World Bank Indicator Data
